Hypatia.depiction_note: 儒勒·莫里斯·加斯帕尔为1908年出版物绘制的希帕提娅想象像，距本人生活年代约1500年，不是古代真实相貌记录。
Hypatia.depiction_note_en: An imagined representation of Hypatia by Jules Maurice Gaspard for a 1908 publication, about 1,500 years after her lifetime; it is not an ancient record of her appearance.
Hypatia.license: Public domain, as recorded by Wikimedia Commons

John Philoponus.commons_file: Ioannes Philoponus – Commentaria De generatione et corruptione, 1540 – BEIC IE9022374.jpg
John Philoponus.depiction_note: 未取得可核实的人物肖像。此图为斐洛波努斯《论生成与消灭》评注1540年印本扉页（BEIC馆藏），属于著作图像，不是人物肖像。
John Philoponus.depiction_note_en: No verified portrait was obtained. This is the title page of the 1540 printed edition of Philoponus’s commentary on On Generation and Corruption (BEIC collection), a work image rather than a portrait.
John Philoponus.license: Public domain, as recorded by Wikimedia Commons

Brahmagupta.commons_file: Pṛthūdhaka’s 10th century commentary on Brahmagupta’s Brāhmasphuṭasiddhānta.jpg
Brahmagupta.depiction_note: 未取得可核实的同时代肖像。此图为与婆罗摩笈多《梵天明悉檀多》及普利图达卡评注有关的手稿图页，英国图书馆藏号IO San 1304；不是作者肖像或本人亲笔，图像记录对抄本年代的表述不一致，故不据此断定年代。
Brahmagupta.depiction_note_en: No verified contemporary likeness was obtained. This manuscript page relates to Brahmagupta’s Brāhmasphuṭasiddhānta and Pṛthūdhaka’s commentary (British Library, IO San 1304). It is neither a portrait nor a verified autograph. The image record gives inconsistent dating, so no date for this copy is asserted here.
Brahmagupta.license: Public domain, as recorded by Wikimedia Commons
Brahmagupta.artist: British Library, IO San 1304 / Pṛthūdhaka and Brahmagupta
Brahmagupta.credit: British Library, IO San 1304 / Pṛthūdhaka and Brahmagupta

Thābit ibn Qurra.commons_file: Conica of Apollonius of Perga fol. 162b and 164a.jpg
Thābit ibn Qurra.depiction_note: 未取得可核实的人物肖像。此图为1070年阿拉伯文《圆锥曲线论》手稿图页（牛津大学博德利图书馆MS. Marsh 667，fol.162b及164a），关联萨比特参与的译校传统；不是本人亲笔或肖像。
Thābit ibn Qurra.depiction_note_en: No verified portrait was obtained. These pages are from a 1070 Arabic manuscript of Apollonius’s Conics (Bodleian Libraries, MS. Marsh 667, fols. 162b and 164a), associated with the translation and revision tradition in which Thābit participated. They are neither his autograph nor a portrait.

Witelo.depiction_note: 《透视学》手稿中的作者形象小画及正文，图像来源记为十三世纪末。中世纪作者小画不能据此视为经核实的真实面貌记录；此处作为著作图像使用。
Witelo.depiction_note_en: An author miniature and text from a manuscript of Perspectiva, dated in the image record to the late thirteenth century. The medieval author miniature is not a verified record of Witelo’s actual appearance; it is presented as a work image.
Witelo.license: Public domain, as recorded by Wikimedia Commons

Theodoric of Freiberg.depiction_note: 德国弗赖贝格福尔图娜喷泉上表现狄奥多里克的后世雕塑细部，Unukorno摄于2012年。是纪念性人物塑像，不是经核实的中世纪面貌记录。
Theodoric of Freiberg.depiction_note_en: Detail of a later commemorative sculpture representing Theodoric on the Fortuna fountain in Freiberg, Germany, photographed by Unukorno in 2012. It is not a verified medieval likeness.

Kamal al-Din al-Farisi.depiction_note: 法里西《光学修订书》手稿图页，来源记录为1309年并归为作者手稿，藏于Adilnor Collection。此图展示光学著作与示意图，不是人物肖像。
Kamal al-Din al-Farisi.depiction_note_en: A manuscript page of al-Fārisī’s Revision of Optics, described in the source record as an autograph dated 1309, in the Adilnor Collection. It shows optical text and diagrams, not a portrait.

Thomas Newcomen.depiction_note: 未取得可核实的人物肖像。此图为达特茅斯展示的纽科门式蒸汽机，Chris Allen摄于2011年，属于仪器照片；不应标为纽科门本人或1712年原机。
Thomas Newcomen.depiction_note_en: No verified portrait was obtained. Chris Allen’s 2011 photograph shows the Newcomen-type engine displayed at Dartmouth. It is an instrument image, not a portrait or a claim to show the original 1712 engine.

Stephen Gray (scientist).depiction_note: 未取得可核实的格雷肖像。此图为诺莱1746年《物体电学论》卷首插画，展示其重现与格雷导电研究相关的“悬空男孩”实验；图中人物不能标为格雷本人。
Stephen Gray (scientist).depiction_note_en: No verified portrait of Gray was obtained. This frontispiece from Nollet’s 1746 Essai sur l’électricité des corps shows Nollet’s version of the suspended electric-boy experiment associated with Gray’s conduction research. The figures must not be identified as Gray.
Stephen Gray (scientist).license: Public domain, as recorded by Wikimedia Commons

Charles François de Cisternay du Fay.commons_file: Charles François de Cisternay du Fay.jpg
Charles François de Cisternay du Fay.depiction_note: 迪费的历史版画，Commons署名雕刻者为Émile Thomas。文件对制作世纪和作者信息的标注存在不一致，故不据此断言制作年代或同时代写生；作为后世人物图像呈现。
Charles François de Cisternay du Fay.depiction_note_en: A historical engraving of du Fay, attributed in the Commons record to Émile Thomas. The record’s century and creator information are inconsistent, so neither a creation date nor a contemporary sitting is asserted. It is presented as a later representation.
Charles François de Cisternay du Fay.license: Public domain, as recorded by Wikimedia Commons
Charles François de Cisternay du Fay.artist: Émile Thomas, as attributed in the source record
Charles François de Cisternay du Fay.credit: Émile Thomas, as attributed in the source record

Benjamin Robins.depiction_note: 未取得可核实且适用的人物肖像。此图为罗宾斯1742年《火炮原理新论》扉页，属于著作图像，不是人物肖像。
Benjamin Robins.depiction_note_en: No verified suitable portrait was obtained. This is the title page of Robins’s New Principles of Gunnery (1742), a work image rather than a portrait.
Benjamin Robins.license: Public domain, as recorded by Wikimedia Commons

Franz Aepinus.depiction_note: 未取得可核实且适用的人物肖像。此图为埃皮努斯1759年《电与磁理论的尝试》扉页，属于著作图像，不是人物肖像。
Franz Aepinus.depiction_note_en: No verified suitable portrait was obtained. This is the title page of Aepinus’s Tentamen theoriae electricitatis et magnetismi (1759), a work image rather than a portrait.
Franz Aepinus.license: Public domain, as recorded by Wikimedia Commons

John Michell.depiction_note: 未取得可核实的米歇尔肖像。此图为卡文迪许1798年测定地球密度论文中的扭秤装置示意图；其方法和原装置源于米歇尔，图示是卡文迪许使用的装置，不是米歇尔本人肖像。
John Michell.depiction_note_en: No verified portrait of Michell was obtained. This diagram comes from Cavendish’s 1798 paper on the density of the Earth. Michell originated the torsion-balance method and apparatus, but the drawing shows Cavendish’s apparatus, not Michell’s appearance.
John Michell.license: Public domain, as recorded by Wikimedia Commons

George Atwood.commons_file: Atwood, George – Description of the experiments, intended to illustrate a course of lectures, on the principles of natural philosophy, 1781 – BEIC 586027.jpg
George Atwood.depiction_note: 未取得可核实且适用的人物肖像。此图为阿特伍德实验物理讲义说明的1781年意大利译本扉页（BEIC馆藏），属于著作图像，不是人物肖像。
George Atwood.depiction_note_en: No verified suitable portrait was obtained. This is the title page of a 1781 Italian translation of Atwood’s description of experiments for lectures in natural philosophy (BEIC collection), a work image rather than a portrait.
George Atwood.license: Public domain, as recorded by Wikimedia Commons

Pierre Prevost (physicist).depiction_note: 1896年刊载的普雷沃历史版画，与《瑞士历史辞典》所载据菲尔曼·马索约1810年生前肖像制作的版画相符；本文件具体刻制年代尚未核实，不应把1896年刊载时间当作原肖像创作时间。
Pierre Prevost (physicist).depiction_note_en: An engraving of Prevost published in 1896, matching the engraving described by the Historical Dictionary of Switzerland as after Firmin Massot’s lifetime portrait of about 1810. The engraving’s precise production date is unverified; its 1896 publication date is not the date of the original portrait.
Pierre Prevost (physicist).license: Public domain, as recorded by Wikimedia Commons
Pierre Prevost (physicist).artist: Journal Officiel Illustré de l’Exposition Nationale Suisse, Genève (1896)
Pierre Prevost (physicist).credit: Journal Officiel Illustré de l’Exposition Nationale Suisse, Genève (1896)

George Green (mathematician).depiction_note: 未取得可核实的人物肖像。此图为1871年《已故乔治·格林数学论文集》扉页，取自美国物理联合会尼尔斯·玻尔图书馆馆藏；属于著作图像，不是人物肖像。
George Green (mathematician).depiction_note_en: No verified portrait was obtained. This is the title page of the 1871 Mathematical Papers of the Late George Green, from the Niels Bohr Library & Archives at the American Institute of Physics. It is a work image rather than a portrait.
George Green (mathematician).license: Public domain, as recorded by Wikimedia Commons
George Green (mathematician).artist: George Green / Niels Bohr Library & Archives, AIP
George Green (mathematician).credit: George Green / Niels Bohr Library & Archives, AIP

Alexis Thérèse Petit.depiction_note: 未取得可核实且适用的珀蒂肖像。此图从里昂高师网站所存PDF直接提取，为珀蒂与杜隆1819年热学论文的实验数据表，显示比热、原子相对质量及其乘积；属于论文图像，不是人物肖像。
Alexis Thérèse Petit.depiction_note_en: No verified suitable portrait of Petit was obtained. Extracted directly from a PDF hosted by ENS de Lyon, this is the experimental table from Petit and Dulong’s 1819 heat paper, listing specific heats, relative atomic weights and their products. It is a paper image rather than a portrait.
Alexis Thérèse Petit.license: Public-domain original: Petit and Dulong, Annales de chimie et de physique 10 (1819), pp. 395–413; faithful scan, no separate scan license stated.
Alexis Thérèse Petit.credit: Petit and Dulong (1819); scan reproduced in an ENS de Lyon-hosted teaching resource
Alexis Thérèse Petit.extraction_method: pdfimages -png; original embedded raster image, without the modern PDF caption

Adrien-Marie Legendre.depiction_note: 朱利安-莱奥波德·布瓦伊约1820年所绘勒让德漫画像，为2009年重新辨认的同时代图像。常见的另一幅正面油画像实际是政治家路易·勒让德，不能用于此人。
Adrien-Marie Legendre.depiction_note_en: A contemporary caricature of the mathematician by Julien-Léopold Boilly, circa 1820, reidentified in 2009. The frequently reproduced formal painted portrait depicts the politician Louis Legendre and must not be assigned to this mathematician.
